name: hcb-dev
description: Personal developer baseline: a connected set of skills — turn tasks or issues into sliced, reviewed work; resolve dependency versions from the registry (Dependabot in sync); seed .gitignore; review a change locally (Codex + multi-reviewer consolidation); complete finished work by mode — merged locally into its parent, or an open change request (PR/MR), with the full review-and-merge drive on GitHub; and sweep a repository's git residue (merged branches, stale worktrees).
